description: Defines the IActivity interface for workflow activities, including properties and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: IActivity
classes.description: Interface for workflow activity with properties and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves possible outcomes when the activity is executed.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Retrieves possible outcomes when the activity is executed.

methods.name: CanExecuteAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if the activity can transition to the next outcome.

methods.name: OnInputReceivedAsync
methods.description: Handles input received before workflow start or resume.

methods.name: OnWorkflowStartingAsync
methods.description: Called when a workflow is about to start.

methods.name: OnWorkflowStartedAsync
methods.description: Called when a workflow has started.

methods.name: OnWorkflowResumingAsync
methods.description: Called when a workflow is about to resume.

methods.name: OnWorkflowResumedAsync
methods.description: Called when a workflow has resumed.

methods.name: OnWorkflowRestartingAsync
methods.description: Called when a workflow is about to restart.

methods.name: OnWorkflowRestartedAsync
methods.description: Called when a workflow has restarted.

methods.name: OnActivityExecutingAsync
methods.description: Called before an activity is executed.

methods.name: OnActivityExecutedAsync
methods.description: Called after an activity has been executed.
